quest.title: Banquet of Parting
quest.description: What can we do for these youkai? If you were to answer honestly, it could only be a grand farewell party.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x525, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Light x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and look for Yae Miko

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Well hello there, my little helpers, so nice of you to join me. You're right on time, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, as if we had a choice. We just want our paychecks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Miko, what exactly do we have to do to make this Hyakkiyakou happen?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, to be clear, we actually have no idea what it even means.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: It might sound ominous, but to put it simply, the Hyakkiyakou is just a gathering of the youkai.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Back in the day, at youkai gatherings, once everyone had had plenty to drink, one by one they'd start soaring into the sky with their youkai powers. There were so many of them that their silhouettes would block out the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: But now, the youkai memories that leak from the Ley Lines are weak. They are no longer able to fly.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: So, I will be performing a convocation ritual for them, gathering all the wandering memories together in one place.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: When the time comes, they will gather in the sky above the Grand Narukami Shrine. Once their energy is spent, they will be satisfied, and return to where they belong.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see. I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: All the preparations for the ritual have actually been made well in advance. Remember the incantation and the mention of "moonless night" that I added to our novel?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, something about reciting "The Secret Spells of Lady Kitsune" on a moonless night.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: That's the one. Actually, it's not a wish-granting incantation at all. It's a spell to help calm the Ley Line memories.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: When that time comes, let's all pitch in and help send them on their way!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need from me?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I will start the ritual preparations shortly, and at that time, I need you to do two things:

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: First, tell the shrine maidens to leave the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: During the Hyakkiyakou, a whole swarm of youkai memories will be hanging around in the air above the Grand Narukami Shrine. Having the shrine maidens leave avoids the bothersome issue of someone potentially getting possessed.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: After that, I will commence the ritual, and the memories will begin to congregate. This will take some time. I need you at the foot of Mt. Yougou during this part to keep an eye on nearby monster activity.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The memories are normally dispersed, and don't pose a threat. But when their energy is concentrated, it is likely to disturb the monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: They may see this as an opportunity to try and make it up the mountain. I need you to fend them off so that that doesn't happen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, got it. Then what?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, if at that point you felt like coming to the shrine and getting a close-up view of the youkai, I wouldn't say no.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Okay, {NICKNAME}, let's get going!

talks.objective: Tell the shrine maidens to leave the shrine temporarily

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: ...Descend the mountain? Are those Lady Guuji's orders?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, Miko said the ritual she's gonna perform soon might pose a physical danger to you all.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: I see... I'll evacuate everyone right away. What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll be taking care of a couple other things for her, and once we're done with that, we're gonna come back and do the ritual together.

choices.text: Because we want to make sure she's safe, too.

response.speaker: Maki
response.text: It seems like Lady Guuji places great trust in you.

response.speaker: Maki
response.text: Lady Guuji's never allowed anyone else to be in her presence when she's conducted rituals like this in the past.

response.speaker: Maki
response.text: Thank you for helping with the ritual, and... good luck.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we're much stronger than we look!

choices.text: Because we want to see the youkai.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... The Sacred Sakura doesn't seem to show any signs of corruption. Seems like the spirits can't affect it directly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If that's the case, they could definitely possess monsters to attack the Grand Narukami Shrine, just like Yae Miko said.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's hurry down the mountain!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}, those monsters are getting real riled up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's got a bad feeling about this... Still, why aren't they attacking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's not yet night.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true. Maybe they're waiting for a moonless night...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's keep watch here and wait for night to fall!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hm, just as I thought, the ritual went very smoothly. Thank you both.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Miko, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hmm? I'm great.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, the look on your face just now...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I'm fine, seriously. Really! I...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Huh... Honestly, you two...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miko...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Fine, well if you're dead-set on doing something for me, you can treat me to a meal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure, no problem! A meal it is!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A meal? It's a deal!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Okay. Well, see you soon, then.

talks.objective: Go to the main road under Mt. Yougou

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These monsters look really riled up!

choices.text: We can't let them up the mountain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup yup! Let's get rid of them as fast as we can! Then we can get back in time to see the youkai!

choices.text: Let's get rid of them, for Miko.

talks.objective: Stop the affected monsters from getting up the mountain

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Ah, my little friends, there you are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miko... what is this? You started eating without us!?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I did, yes. You're paying, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The thought of being able to eat the most expensive dishes and drink the finest sake, all for absolutely free... Oh, I just couldn't wait any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Ah, Boss, see these two faces here? Remember them. They're the ones picking up the bill later.

dialogues.speaker: Okazaki Rikuto
dialogues.text: Alrighty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: What's gotten into you? Come on, sit yourselves down.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: You have to try this fish. It's found exclusively in the waters around Seirai Island. They shipped it to Inazuma overnight, and it was still alive right up until I ordered it.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Or maybe you'd rather try this? I know, I know — I normally can't bring myself to drink sake this expensive either.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: If you don't drink alcohol, that's fine too. There are all kinds of fruit juices covering the whole price spectrum.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Grrr... Miko! You are outrageous!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Last time we were here working on the novel, all you ordered for us was the plainest Kushikatsu!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Huh? Strange, I remember no such thing.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh. So what? You did offer to treat me to a meal, didn't you? Anyway, I am something of a VIP, you know. Wouldn't you find it embarrassing to treat me anything short of lavishly?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miko, this meal is going to be super expensive. Aren't you afraid we won't be able to afford it?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hehe, oh, don't you worry about that. You can most definitely afford it... They're still printing your light novel by the batch, you know. You have quite the generous payment due.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aaaah, darn it!!! She tricked us into this, {NICKNAME}! Miko was after our Mora from the very beginning!

choices.text: Shouldn't have let our guard down...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hahaha, oh, the looks on your faces right now. Too perfect. Hahaha.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh, by the way — since nobody's wishes came true on the moonless night, novels with incantations are no longer in vogue.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: So you'll have to come up with something new for the next chapter of "The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler."

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: The deadline is looming... I'm counting on you.

choices.text: We've been taken for a ride...
Kushikatsu and Fried Tofu. That was it.

talks.objective: Return to the Grand Narukami Shrine

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Thank you for the meal. I thoroughly enjoyed myself today.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Oh, did I mention? Ei saw that convocation ritual we performed over the Grand Narukami Shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I know she can be pig-headed, but it still took me by surprise when she wrote me a long and sternly worded letter about it, chastising me for "taking this whole thing much too far."

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Ugh, I hardly see what all the fuss is about. Everyone seemed perfectly happy to me.

talks.objective: Say farewell to the youkai within the Ley Lines
Wait until the appointed time (the following day)

dialogues.speaker: Kyouta
dialogues.text: Ugh, the wait is unbearable! How has the next chapter of "The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler" not been released yet!

dialogues.speaker: Oosuke
dialogues.text: It was quite a surprise when the "moonless night" finally came.

dialogues.speaker: Tetsuo
dialogues.text: Yeah, that huge black cloud over Mt. Yougou that night. It just seemed to form out of nowhere!

dialogues.speaker: Oosuke
dialogues.text: But then nothing happened after I made a wish using the method in that book.

dialogues.speaker: Tetsuo
dialogues.text: *sigh* I guess light novels are just fiction after all, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Oosuke
dialogues.text: That night was definitely the nail in the coffin for the "incantations from novels" fad. Still, something tells me "The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler" will remain an interesting series for a long time to come!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon can't see Miko anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess she's not out here. Uh... maybe she went inside already? Let's head in and look for her.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As night falls, the monsters slowly congregate in this area...
